content:
- Overestimate prices in the short term after recent spikes; model tends to overshoot and fail to correct quickly.
- Underestimate prices when the recent 30-day average is falling; model reacts too slowly to downward momentum.
- Exhibit persistent bias toward higher prices when historical volatility is low; model overconfident in upward trends.
- Lag in response to sharp downward moves; model often fails to recognize early signs of price collapse.
- Mean reversion is underemphasized; model holds high forecasts too long after peaks, ignoring natural correction cycles.
- Overfit to recent high values; model ignores longer-term trend reversals and fails to adjust for structural shifts.
